font_list.doc: Retrieve a paginated list of all available fonts on the platform. Calls stored procedure font_list with the requested page number. Results are paginated server-side.

page.description: Page number for pagination. Defaults to 1 if not provided.

returns.description: Paginated list of font records returned by stored procedure font_list

category.description: Font classification category (e.g. serif, sans-serif, monospace)

errors.message: Database error executing stored procedure font_list

search.doc: Search fonts by name or keyword using a paginated full-text search. Calls stored procedure plf_search_fonts with the search value and page number. Returns fonts matching the query string.

value.description: Search keyword or font name to query. Defaults to "a" if not provided.

page.description: Page number for paginated search results. Defaults to 1 if not provided.

returns.description: Paginated list of font records matching the search value, returned by stored procedure plf_search_fonts

name.description: Font family name matching the search query

errors.message: Database error executing stored procedure plf_search_fonts

files.doc: Retrieve the list of all font files available on the platform. Calls stored procedure font_get_files with no additional parameters. Returns file records for all registered font assets.

returns.description: List of font file records returned by stored procedure font_get_files

font_id.description: Reference to the parent font record

filename.description: Font file name including extension (e.g. OpenSans-Regular.woff2)

format.description: Font file format (e.g. woff, woff2, ttf, otf)

url.description: Accessible URL or path to the font file

errors.message: Database error executing stored procedure font_get_files
